value.rationale: The result answers a nontrivial second-order question naturally posed by the published Lyapunov-exponent plateau. Across a nonconjugate open family, a measurable lag-one covariance changes linearly in the parameter while the integrated variance stays exactly \(2/27\); this is a structural cancellation of lagged correlations not determined by the known density/mean. The certificate and closed formula supply a reproducible future reference for fluctuations and finite-time predictability.
